about.title: About the Burning Shadows set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Burning Shadows is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 4 August 2017. It has 169 cards: 147 in the main set and 22 secret rares. There are also 116 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 147 main set cards), the Master set (263 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 285 cards, adding the 22 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
